spec.claim_summary: Trade EMA 8/21 crosses with exit if price crosses the 21-day EMA and a maximum 6-day hold.

claimed.other: 6 positions were taken in 10 months (304 days), an average of one every 51 days

assumptions: Entry is long 8-day EMA crossing above 21-day EMA on daily close.
Monitor for maximum 6 days interpreted as max_hold_bars 6.
Stop just other side of 21-day EMA adjusted daily interpreted as exit when close crosses to other side of 21-day EMA.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim describes symmetric 8/21 EMA crosses in both directions with stop on other side of 21 EMA, but schema allows only one direction; spec compiles the long side only.

evidence.quote: The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross.
If price crosses the 21 day EMA , your setup has failed.
then monitor for a maximum of 6 days.
6 positions were taken in 10 months (304 days), an average of one every 51 days.

audit_majors: direction: Claim says 'The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross' with stop 'just the other side of the 21 day EMA' - symmetric long and short. Spec encodes long-only (8 crosses_above 21, exit crosses_below). Omitting the short side halves the claimed 6 positions and changes profit/loss test.
